AC-059 and this task's Done When name the scanned set verbatim as plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/resolve-project-context.{py,sh,ps1}. TEST-059 scans the human-copy staged candidates instead. That matches this suite's own convention (STAGED is the subject of every case, and the live paths are protected and applied by a human, not authored by T-007), and the log lines print the staged paths, so nothing is concealed. But the implementation report and the verification contract both describe the scanned set as the three Resolver files without disclosing the staged-for-live substitution, so a reader checking AC-059 against the criterion text meets a path mismatch.
